about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of “Survivalist Hustle” — a unique arcade 3D game with a top-down view, where the zombie apocalypse has become a familiar reality!
In this game, you take on the role of a courier faced with the challenging task of delivering crates while battling legions of the undead.
It’s a true symphony of adrenaline and humor, with surprises at every turn!

What makes “Survivalist Hustle” so engaging? The open world serves as your playground, filled with crumbling streets, abandoned buildings, and unexpected dangers around every corner.
Explore every nook and cranny of the city, because you never know what to expect just around the bend!
Zombies are everywhere, but you have the chance to showcase your cleverness and survival skills.

Game Features:

Open world
Fun quests
3D graphics
Difficulty

Dive into “Survivalist Hustle” — an arcade 3D game with a top-down view, where you play as a courier delivering crates in a zombie apocalypse.
Fight off legions of the undead and explore an open world full of unexpected threats!
